title: Development and evaluation of hydrogen peroxide mediated zinc oxide photocatalytic nanoparticles from Peepal (Ficus Religiosa) leaf extract for the treatment of actual tannery wastewater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00713A, Paper
Ganeshkumar Govindasamy, Arjunan Babu Ponnusami
Our findings offer insight into the impact of ZnO nanoparticles produced from Ficus Religiosa leaf extract on photocatalytic degradation of tannery wastewater.
